newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain says jobs data shows better economic outlook.
newsitem.headline: Spain says jobs data shows better economic outlook.

text.p: Spanish third quarter unemployment data showed a strong increase in the number of new jobs, confirming an improvement in the economic outlook, the Economy Ministry said on Tuesday.

"The improvement in expectations on the economic situation is being translated into a significant increase in the incorporation of new people in the labour market, which means that the fall in the number of unemployed is more modest," the ministry said in a statement.
The data showed that the current economic cycle "is being characterised by very intense employment growth in relation to activity," it added.
Spain's jobless rate as measured by the National Statistics Institute INE's quarterly household survey fell to 21.91 percent in the third quarter from 22.26 percent in the second.
